content.text:
The frontend is one SvelteKit catch-all route: [`+page.server.ts`](frontend/src/routes/[...path]/+page.server.ts:7) interprets the URL, loads search or details, and [`App.svelte`](frontend/src/App.svelte:1) renders both inside the shared header/footer.

Smallest coherent integration:

- Add `landing` and `methodology` variants to [`PageModel`](frontend/src/lib/page.ts:8), and render lightweight components through `App.svelte`. Handle these paths before invoking the detail parser or API loader.
- Move search to `/search`; update [`readDetailRoute`](frontend/src/lib/entity-details.ts:11) and [`backToSearch`](frontend/src/lib/entity-details.ts:111). The latter currently returns `/` or `/?q=…`, so missing it would send “Back to search” to the landing screen.
- Keep the wordmark targeting `/`; it already means home. Update the skip link in `App.svelte`, which currently assumes every non-search view is details.
- Search’s URL updates preserve the current pathname, so [`SearchPage.svelte`](frontend/src/SearchPage.svelte:82) needs no route rewriting after it runs at `/search`. Entity links preserve `q` and `strictness` and remain valid.

The visual shell already supplies black background, Manrope, purple accent, visible keyboard focus and a full-height flex column in [`styles.css`](frontend/src/styles.css:1). Scope landing layout rules: global `main` currently adds `74px` top margin and limits width to `800px`, which can undermine a vertically centered single-screen landing.

Testing pitfalls:

- Numerous search tests start at `/` or `/?q=…`; migrate those to `/search`. Detail tests also assert back links to root, including [`entity-details.spec.ts`](frontend/tests/entity-details.spec.ts:630).
- Existing shared URLs use `/?q=…`; redirecting root query URLs to `/search` preserves those links without showing search on ordinary `/`.
- [`tests/backend.ts`](frontend/tests/backend.ts:78) launches the built server and supplies a stub API. New landing tests can prove both buttons navigate and root renders without backend requests.
- No existing methodology page or frontend route exists. Its button needs a working destination.
- UI PRs require screenshots from the running branch, uploaded as GitHub attachments under the supplied AGENTS instructions.
